title: Embedded Systems
tagline: Microcontrollers, embedded C, timers and interrupts, interfaces, sensors and real-time systems
summary: Embedded computers control everything from washing machines to aircraft. This course programs microcontrollers close to the hardware: memory-mapped peripherals, timers and interrupts, serial interfaces, analog input and output, real-time operating systems and the design of reliable, low-power embedded systems.

chapters.title: Microcontrollers
chapters.summary: Microcontroller architecture, memory maps, clocks, reset and general-purpose input and output.

chapters.title: Programming close to the hardware
chapters.summary: Embedded C, registers and bit manipulation, volatile data, startup code and toolchains.

chapters.title: Timers, interrupts and PWM
chapters.summary: Hardware timers, interrupt handling, latency and priorities, and pulse-width modulation.

chapters.title: Serial communication
chapters.summary: UART, SPI, I²C, CAN and USB: protocols, timing and drivers.

chapters.title: Analog interfaces, sensors and actuators
chapters.summary: ADCs and DACs in practice, interfacing sensors, and driving motors, LEDs and relays.

chapters.title: Real-time operating systems
chapters.summary: Tasks, scheduling, rate-monotonic analysis, synchronisation and inter-task communication.

chapters.title: Embedded system design
chapters.summary: Low-power design, reliability, watchdogs, testing and debugging of complete embedded systems.
